articles.title: Why a bug that could have threatened XRP's 100 billion supply cap stayed hidden for years
articles.snippet: The XRP Ledger Foundation said normal parameters never triggered the bug that could have broken XRP's supply cap, which is why it was undetected for years.

articles.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
articles.snippet: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

articles.title: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
articles.snippet: Meta's new flagship beats GPT-6 Astra and Claude on memory, legal and marathon coding tests, but independent rankings still put Anthropic's Opus 5.5 on top.

articles.title: AI Startup Manus Raises $500 Million After China Nixed Meta’s $2 Billion Acquisition
articles.snippet: Manus built a self-driving AI assistant before the hype, sold itself to Meta, then watched Beijing unwind the deal. Its first fresh money since: more than $500 million.
